title: Introduction to Digital Assets
overview: Digital assets use distributed ledgers to represent value, ownership, execution rules, and network participation.
example: Map the structure, cash-flow timing, fees, leverage, liquidity, and source of return before comparing opportunities.

modules.title: Distributed Ledger Technology
modules.explanation: Distributed ledgers coordinate records and ownership across a network using consensus and cryptographic controls. Digital-asset value and risk depend on token rights, network incentives, custody, governance, smart-contract behavior, liquidity, and regulation.
steps: Identify what the token represents and which network validates transfers.
Map issuance, consensus, custody, governance, and economic incentives.
Evaluate security, concentration, liquidity, legal status, and smart-contract failure modes.

Interpret the result, challenge its assumptions, and identify one condition that would change the conclusion.
